# T-1: Build runtime log blocks

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Create the bounded per-flow runtime log block model and stdout/stderr tee behavior used by all flow commands.

## Acceptance Criteria
- .tmp/logs/<flowId>.log and .tmp/logs/no-flow.log are append-only block logs.
- Blocks include runId, sequence, attempt, command, startedAt, endedAt, and exitCode.
- stdout/stderr writes are captured with [stdout] and [stderr] prefixes while visible streams stay unchanged.

## Implementation Notes
Refactor the current RuntimeLog behavior in src/lib/dispatcher.js into class-based values for log block metadata and writing. Preserve the existing 5 MiB max-byte protection per command block. flow get runtime-log is excluded from automatic block creation.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests around dispatcher stdout/stderr capture, sequence assignment, truncation, and visible stdout preservation.
